findings.description: The check was changed from `isinstance(filename, str)` to `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)`, so plain `str` filenames are no longer wrapped in a tuple. A str is not an os.PathLike instance.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `click.edit(filename="foo.txt")`. The str is passed unwrapped to `edit_files`, which iterates it character by character and tries to open each character as a separate file. That breaks the most common usage. The check should be `isinstance(filename, (str, os.PathLike))`.
